title: tc-rate-limit-planner
description:
Plan agent runs under one API rate limit – the day's load against the limit, overflow hatched, a draggable bar per
run and Spread out to lower the peak.

runs.description: The runs. Changed by dragging, the keys and Spread out unless a tc-runs-change listener calls preventDefault()

limit.description: The limit, in tokens per minute

day.description: Where the time axis starts, as epoch ms; by default the UTC midnight before the first run

hours.description: How many hours the axis covers

step.description: The minutes a run moves by, and the chart's resolution

locale.description: The language for numbers and times, e.g. "en-GB"; by default the browser's

timeZone.description: The time zone times are shown in, e.g. "Europe/London"; by default the browser's

start.description: When it starts, as epoch ms

minutes.description: How long it runs, in minutes

tokensPerMinute.description: Its load on the limit while it runs

fixed.description: Must run when it does: drawn, but not dragged or spread
